description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Constant Contact is hiring for its one-year Software Engineering Development Program, a rotational experience for emerging engineers. Participants rotate across engineering teams, build and launch production software, and receive technical training and mentorship before moving into a permanent role.
Software engineering development program participant writing production code and building customer-facing web applications across rotating teams

Responsibilities:
• Rotate through four different teams getting broad experience in areas like frontend, backend, DevOps, etc. This is an opportunity to work on a variety of projects across several teams
• Work with your SEDP cohort on a capstone project for an entire quarter to conclude the program - design, build, test, implement, and launch a customer-facing feature that will be released into production
• Participate in customized technical and soft-skills training throughout the year
• Use existing and emerging technologies such as Java, ReactJS, AWS, Kubernetes, and Ruby - in a CI/CD environment
• Make an immediate impact by writing production code with the help and support of experienced software engineers on each team
• Develop web applications at scale -- used by hundreds of thousands of customers
• Gain guidance from a variety of mentors and managers who will support you throughout the program

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree by May/June 2027 in computer science or similar discipline, or will have equivalent relevant industry experience
• New to the field of software engineering
• Excited to learn and experience web technologies at scale
• Passionate and interested in a broad range of technologies
• Looking to embrace emerging technologies
